description: Compose a video ad from the catalog: pick a preset + setting (+ optional hook), attach a registered product and/or avatar, and the server fills the prompt and routes to the right video model. ASYNC: returns a job id and predicted_usd immediately; poll with check_job { kind: "studio", id } until status is "completed" (url) or "failed". Use studio_catalog to discover ids. Billed to your credit balance. Tip: call studio_preview first (free) to see the composed prompt and predicted_usd.

avatar_id.description: An avatar_id from studio_register_avatar or studio_list_assets (stock avatars included)

final_prompt.description: A director script from studio_expand_prompt (optionally edited). When set it REPLACES the composed prompt

hook.description: Hook id from studio_catalog, e.g. product-hit; omit or "none" for no hook

extra_prompt.description: Extra creative direction appended to the composed prompt

model.description: Override the preset video model slug

preset.description: Preset id from studio_catalog, e.g. ugc, asmr, unboxing

product_id.description: A product_id from studio_register_product or studio_list_assets

project_id.description: File the result under this studio project; omit for your default project

reference_images.description: Extra reference image URLs (http(s) or data:image URI). Each preset caps how many it accepts; the server returns a clear 400 above the cap

setting.description: Setting id from studio_catalog, e.g. kitchen, gym, marble-counter

name: studio_generate
title: Generate a product video ad
